anti_goal_violations.resolution: RESOLVED in iter-24 on two independent grounds, both verified by this evaluator. (1) OWNER DISPOSITION: docs/goal.md "OWNER RULING — J-11 CLOSED" (2026-08-27) item 2 accepts the 10 derived-cache rows in place and forbids cleanup writes; item 3 authorizes exactly the launcher fix. (2) REMEDY LANDED AND VERIFIED: goal_iter_lock_backend_launch_context + the ensure_services_running drift guard (lib/common.sh) and goal-iter-lean.sh reading the locked value; reviewer PASS; this evaluator independently ran tests/automation/test-backend-launch-context.sh (18 passed, 0 failed) and observed the fail-closed refusal fire. No further harm occurred: canonical .db/-wal/-shm are byte-identical to their iter-23 values. RESIDUAL (recorded, not a violation): the guard enforces launch-context CONSISTENCY with whatever was locked at iteration start, not canonical-DB PROTECTION — an iteration needing clone isolation must still supply CHAIN_START_BACKEND_CMD/TRENDORA_CONFIG in the engine's environment BEFORE goal-iter-lean.sh starts.

anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: Iteration spec binding live constraint (docs/phases/goal-market-compass-iter-27.md, BACKGROUND 'Row-count safety'): keep 'every live/canonical-DB action strictly read-only and additive-free (regression checks only, on manifests that already exist and whose runs are already intact)'; TESTING REQUIREMENTS authorized only 2025-04-15 (TC-6) and 2026-08-12 (TC-7) as live requests.
anti_goal_violations.evidence: The LLM browser-QA lane issued an unauthorized GET /api/compass?as_of=2019-03-01 under its UT-J-05 step-7 check (reports/phase-goal-market-compass-iter-27-ui-test-results.llm.md:165-170), minting permanent next_session_manifests row id=26 (as_of 2019-03-01, version 1, retrospective, frozen=1, prospective_eligible=0) and taking the table from 25 to 26 rows. anti_goal_violations.resolution: No enumerated anti-goal is breached: the row is additive (AG-12 forbids mutation/deletion, not creation, and forbids deleting this row now), correctly classified retrospective and prospective_eligible=0 (AG-17), and no live fetch occurred (AG-9). Owner ruling 2026-08-27 item 6 gates 'immutable-manifest mutation', not an additive create-once row produced by the shipped read path, and directs the non-destructive default. Remedy applied: the auditor appended a dated correction to the dev handoff so 26, not 25, is the standing record. Residual is a PROCESS gap only — a browser lane took a permanent write on its own judgment against an explicit prohibition; carried as a lesson, not as an open data defect.
